 Punjab vs Haryana SMAT 2026 live streaming 
 Punjab vs Haryana SMAT Live Streaming: Prabhsimran Singh, Umesh Yadav in Action
 Sportsdunia Desk Published -  Nov 14, 2026, 02:20 AM 2 min comment Add on As Preferred Source Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy The domestic competition in India has moved towards the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy 2026. The tournament is all set to begin on November 14 and one of the teams that will be under spotlight will be Punjab.
 Punjab will open their campaign in Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy 2026 against Haryana on November 14. The match will be played at the Day College Ground in Indore from 9:00 AM IST.
 The Punjab vs Haryana match of SMAT 2026 will be part of Elite Group B. Both the teams will be favorites to qualify from this group as they feature some experienced players. However, the challenge won’t b be easy as they have some other strong teams in their pool.
 The Punjab vs Haryana SMAT 2026 live streaming will begin from 9:00 AM IST. As this match is around the corner, here’s everything you need to know about the Punjab vs Haryana SMAT live stream, telecast and match details.
 Where to Watch Punjab vs Haryana SMAT 2026 Match Live?
 Unfortunately for the fans, the Punjab vs Haryana Syed Mushtaq Ali Tropjhy live streaming is not available. However, they will be available to catch the live action of some other games on JioHotstar app and website.
 If you are unable to watch this match live, Sportsdunia Live Cricket Score will provide ball-by-ball commentary, real-time score updates and match details. Adding to it, BCCI's official website will also provided all the information related to the match.
 Advertisement
 Punjab Favorites With Star Players On Their Side
 One of the players that will be to watch out to for will be Prabhsimran Singh . The wicketkeeper-batter has been at the top of his game in the T20 format since the last few years. He has been amongst the best batsmen in India recently. His form will hold key for Punjab as they eye to win another SMAT title.
 Another key player to watch out for will be Umesh Yadav. Ever since he has moved to Punjab, he has been lethal will the ball. Even in the Ranji Trophy, he has shown great form and will be looking to continue it.
